name: Azora
seen_with: NVIDIA; Andreessen Horowitz; Altimeter (Volta Infra Holdings, 2026-08-04)
rationale: Named in Volta's own launch announcement as BOTH an equity co-lead and the provider of a 5bn non-dilutive AI Infrastructure Program financing future AI factories against long-term contracted cash flows. A European infrastructure manager underwriting GPU-datacenter capex at that scale sits directly on the capital path the engine tracks, and it is the debt layer under a round the tracked VC names only led the equity of.

name: Anthropic
rationale: Signed a 20-year, ~401MW lease worth ~19bn of contracted revenue (up to ~33bn with extensions) per TeraWulf's 8-K. Anthropic currently appears in the universe only as a RECIPIENT of capital (Amazon's 10bn follow-on). This filing shows it is also a very large DEPLOYER of capital into physical datacenter capacity, which is a different and unmodelled role.

name: Greenoaks
seen_with: Neil Mehta (tracked individual) - Greenoaks Prime Radiant Founders LP / Offshore LP, Form D/A 2026-07-14
rationale: Raised ~692m across two SPVs into a single codenamed position ('Prime Radiant'), 576.5m from just 11 investors onshore plus 115.5m from 4 offshore. Neil Mehta is already on the individuals watchlist but the firm itself is untracked, so the vehicle - which is where the money actually sits - is invisible to the engine today. Concentrated single-asset SPVs of this size are a high-signal pattern.

name: Matter Venture Partners

rationale: Named as a participating investor in Volta's Seed + Series A in the company's own launch announcement. Small relative to the co-investors, but it is co-investing directly alongside four tracked or newly-discovered allocators in AI infrastructure.

name: Michael Dell family office

rationale: Volta's launch page names Michael Dell's family office as a participating investor. Dell is not on the individuals watchlist despite Dell Technologies being a direct beneficiary of AI-server demand - personal capital flowing into an NVIDIA Cloud Partner is exactly the operator-investing-in-the-stack pattern the individuals class exists to catch.

name: Bitdeer
rationale: Volta's 133MW Norwegian AI factory is being built with Bitdeer as infrastructure partner under a 10bn strategic partnership with an unnamed frontier AI lab. Bitdeer is a listed operator converting bitcoin-mining power sites into AI capacity - a repeat pattern (cf. TeraWulf, Hut 8, Galaxy) worth tracking as a class of datacenter counterparty.

name: Lightspeed Venture Partners
